summary:
Project Title: ASTRONAUT ACADEMY: Lunar Outpost Vanguard
Core Theme & Target Audience: A browser-based mission control simulator designed for children aged 7–12 to make real aerospace engineering trade-offs tangible, educational, and fun.
The Problem Addressed: Space-themed STEM content often either oversimplifies real-world engineering constraints or presents them in a way that is too complex for young learners.
The Solution: A lightweight dashboard where junior astronauts manage a lunar base outpost by balancing three critical survival parameters while handling random space weather events.
details: Astronaut Academy: Lunar Outpost is an interactive, browser-based space mission simulation designed for children aged 7–12 to teach aerospace engineering constraints through real-time resource management of Power, Life Support, and Radiation Shielding. Built using HTML5, Tailwind CSS, and Vanilla JavaScript, the project bridges the gap between complex STEM concepts and early education via engaging survival mechanics, random emergency events, and traceable lunar science. It emphasizes frictionless accessibility and low cognitive load, fostering problem-solving skills and scientific curiosity without requiring software installations.
